title: Index Advisory Spec Compiler
description: Compiles the index advisory specification for a feature or query set. Enforces: every index recommendation has a rationale tied to a query pattern, per-table index counts are within limits, redundant indexes are flagged, write-heavy tables are not over-indexed, and removal recommendations include a reason.

error_codes.IAS001: index-advisory-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: indexes[] with table, columns[], index_type
error_codes.IAS002: Index recommendation missing rationale — every index must reference the query pattern or access pattern it accelerates
error_codes.IAS003: Table exceeds maximum recommended index count — excessive indexes degrade write performance and bloat storage
error_codes.IAS004: Redundant index detected — two indexes provide overlapping coverage; the narrower one should be removed
error_codes.IAS005: Write-heavy table is over-indexed — high-churn tables pay a write penalty for every index; remove indexes not on hot read paths
error_codes.IAS006: Index removal recommendation missing reason — document why the index is unused or redundant before flagging for removal
